description: County expansion batch 3: home sources for counties still without one after batches 1 and 2, core Tri-State counties first, then western Kentucky, southern Illinois and southeast Missouri (Missouri is never Tri-State). Off unless EXPANDED_SOURCES_ENABLED=true and SOURCE_BATCHES lists b3 (api/_sources.js). Entries with `fallback` are Google News searches, labeled google_news_site (a publisher's own local section, used when its RSS is rate-limited or missing) or google_news_towns (the county's towns, used only where no working local feed exists); they share the gnews rate group (api/news.js RATE_GROUPS). Each entry's evidence record is data/sources/evidence/<id>.json (scripts/verify-source.js).
